_comment: CANONICAL WIRE PAYLOADS for the store-embed RPC arms (Phase 40, plans 40-02 / 40-05 / 40-07).
This file is the SINGLE shared artifact both sides of the TS->Rust boundary assert against:
It exists because a live gate on 2026-09-05 found store_embed_open/set_bounds/navigate
shipping POSITIONAL arrays while the Rust parsers read a single OBJECT. Every unit test on
both sides was green: the TS suite drove the real transport into a JS test handler (real
transport, fake counterparty) and the Rust parsers had no tests at all. Nothing crossed the
boundary, so nothing could see the mismatch. Editing one side of this file without the other
must break a test -- that is the whole point of it.
